question: The Kanchenjunga peak is located in which sub-division of Himalaya from the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Darjeeling and Sikkim Himalayas.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kanchenjunga:-**

 
 
• **​**It is the **third-highest mountain peak **in the world and is located in th**e eastern Himalayas, **specifically between **Nepal and Sikkim, India.**
 
• **Darjeeling and Sikkim Himalayas **are part of the **Eastern Himalayan range**, which is known for its rich biodiversity and cultural heritage.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kashmir Himalayas:-**

 
 
• These​** **are located in the** western part of the Himalayan range** and are known for their scenic beauty and adventure sports opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Himachal and Uttaranchal Himalayas:-**
 
 
• These​ are located in the **central part of the Himalayan range** and are known for their **hill stations, trekking trails, and religious sites.**
 
 
 
• **Arunachal Himalayas:-**
 
 
• These are located in the **easternmost part of the Himalayan range** and are known for their** rugged terrain, diverse wildlife, and tribal culture.​**
